claim: The release notes dated July 14, 2026 say Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 4.x brokers deployed in Multi-AZ Cluster deployment mode now support configurable EBS disk storage sizes, set when creating or updating an eligible broker in increments of 5 GB, up to the maximum for the instance size.
question: When did Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ add configurable storage size (release notes date)?

qualifiers.scope: configurable EBS disk storage size of Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 4.x brokers in Multi-AZ Cluster deployment mode

note: d028. Date boundary: the release notes row says July 14, 2026 and the What's New post says Jul 15, 2026 (fact mq-change-2026-07-configurable-storage-whats-new). Rule: GA after 2026-07-15 is not examinable yet; adjudicator decides.
